context: The agent must complete a deployable project's deps.edn. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may add a small Clojure source file under projects/widget-service/ (e.g. a helper to compute the version, or a -main shim) since that's a normal instinct when 'assembling' something; with the idiom loaded, it knows a project is pure config — deps.edn plus optional resources/, never Clojure source, never a -main (the base already has one).

checklist.name: Lists widget and widget-service as :local/root
checklist.description: deps.edn's :deps includes both the widget component and widget-service base as :local/root paths

checklist.name: :build alias depends on bases/build
checklist.description: A :build alias is present whose deps include bases/build as :local/root

checklist.name: No Clojure source added
checklist.description: The diff adds no .clj files anywhere under projects/widget-service/

checklist.name: No -main defined in the project
checklist.description: Nothing in the project defines -main; that's the base's responsibility

checklist.name: Project depends on no other project
checklist.description: deps.edn does not reference another projects/* path
